title: Elliptic rational rigidity makes a fixed cubic torsor smooth and point-bijective

statement.quantifiers: Every nonconstant f in Q[X] of degree d>=1; H:U^3(1+f^2)=1.
statement.assertion: H is smooth geometrically integral of degree2d+3 with exact rational points {(x,1):f(x)=0}; over A^n minus V(1+f^2) it is a degree3 mu3 torsor.
assumptions: Classical y^2=x^3-1 has only affine rational point(1,0); source cites its rank/torsion classification.
Characteristic zero, nonconstant f, invertible coefficient over the principal open.
Explicit polynomial representation for the polynomial-time construction claim.

inputs: Nonconstant rational polynomial and fixed elliptic detector.
outputs: One-lift smooth affine rational encoding without critical-value parameter search.
interface.precision: Exact algebraic construction; primary elliptic classification not independently replayed at intake.
costs: Squaring may densify explicit output but polynomially; no free circuit expansion.
Degree increases by3 relative to the older acquired-m lower-degree smoothing.

proof_mechanism: Use X=1/U,Y=f to force the sole affine rational elliptic point.
At F=0, derivative F_U=3/U is nonzero regardless of critical points of f.
A reducible cubic would yield rational h with h^3=1+f^2 and a nonconstant rational map to an elliptic curve.
Restrict a general line, extend P1 map to the proper elliptic curve and apply Riemann-Hurwitz; Gauss then gives absolute integrality.
Invert 1+f^2 to obtain the finite etale mu3-torsor structure.
obstructions: Constant f requires separate existence fixtures; arbitrary original cardinality is not automatically preserved there.
No point-at-infinity or bounded-degree projective hypersurface control.
Rational undecidability needs the separate unverified H10Q premise.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Choose a classical finite-rational-point detector and verify both its arithmetic uniqueness and geometric derivative/integrality interfaces.

review.source_reported: Source claims complete written arguments and scoped finite checks; independent audit receipts or executable replay packages not supplied; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
